candidates.change_summary: Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' so that a successful call returns false instead of true.
Replace the loop condition `i<_tos.length` with `i<=_tos.length`, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert instead of returning true.
Replace the successful boolean return `true` with `false`.
Replace the require that the input token list is non-empty with a require that it is empty, causing non-empty calls to revert and empty calls to succeed/revert differently.
Change the transferFrom selector hash to an unrelated signature, so the external call invokes a different selector and its success/failure behavior can differ.
Change the loop condition from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length, adding one extra iteration that can cause an out-of-bounds access or different call count.
Remove the require(_s) check after the external call, so failed calls no longer make the transaction revert.
Return false instead of true from every successful call path, changing the observable return value.
Change the loop index initialization to uint i = 1, skipping the first token in the list and changing the call sequence.
Remove the requirement that the _tos array is non-empty.
Change the selector to the ERC20 transfer(address,uint256) signature instead of transferFrom.
Change the loop initialization so it starts from index 1.
Change the loop condition to iterate one fewer time.
Change the loop increment from ++ to --.
Swap the from and _tos[i] arguments in the external call.
Remove the require(_s) check so failed external calls are ignored.
Return false instead of true after a successful loop.
Replace the require in the for loop with require(false) to always revert.
Replace the success check require with a no-op (delete only the require, keep the low-level call).
Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) precondition with require(false).
Insert an early return false before any logic.
Replace the final return true with return false.
Delete the require that _tos.length is greater than zero, allowing empty _tos arrays to return true instead of reverting.
Change the loop bound to allow processing exactly one extra index, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert when _tos is non-empty.
Ignore the success flag from the external call so failed calls no longer revert this function.
Make the function always return false instead of true after successful execution.
Compute the call selector for transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, causing calls to hit a different or missing function and generally revert.
Swap the from and recipient addresses in the encoded call, changing callee-observable behavior and causing different or failed transfers.
Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) guard so empty _tos arrays no longer revert.
Change the selector string to a non-existent function signature so all external calls fail and the contract reverts.
Change the loop condition from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length causing an out-of-bounds access and revert.
Delete the require(_s) line so failed external calls no longer cause a revert.
Change the return value from true to false so the function completes without reverting but returns a different boolean.
